name: Anaconda3
tagline: Your machine learning Env work with Jupyter Lab
description: Your machine learning Env work with Jupyter Lab

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  anaconda3:
    container_name: anaconda3
    image: continuumio/anaconda3:2024.10-1
    network_mode: bridge
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - LANG=C.UTF-8
      - LC_ALL=C.UTF-8
      - PATH=/opt/conda/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
    ports:
      - target: 8888
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/notebooks
        target: /opt/notebooks
    command:
      - /bin/bash
      - -c
      - conda install -c conda-forge jupyterlab -y --quiet && jupyter lab --notebook-dir=/opt/notebooks --ip='*' --port=8888 --no-browser --allow-root
    labels:
      icon: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/LisonEvf/CasaOS-AppStore@main/Apps/Anaconda3/icon.svg
notes: After installation, please check the token in the container log (My Apps, Logs).
